criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Add to Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a specific track, album, or artist to an existing or new playlist.

categories.name: Weather Query
categories.definition: User requests a weather forecast or condition check for a specific location and time.

categories.name: Movie Showtimes
categories.definition: User seeks movie schedules or showtimes for specific films or theaters.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: User instructs the assistant to play music, which may include specifying an artist, genre, album, track, or platform.

categories.name: Restaurant Booking
categories.definition: User wants to reserve a table or book a spot at a restaurant or eating establishment.

categories.name: Rate Item
categories.definition: User wants to assign a score, star rating, or point value to a book, album, essay, or other creative work.

categories.name: Find Creative Work
categories.definition: User searches for a specific creative work such as a book, movie, game, soundtrack, or image.
